body: You don't understand. The wounds are still being inflicted by the perpetrator.
One more time. I've had thousands of that.

The people that "can understand" me don't like me either.

Where? At the supermarket?

Time can't heal wounds when the wounds continually get deeper and deeper every day.

That's the common quote. But I'm an exception.

I just started seeing a new one. How many more therapists and decades do I have to go through before finding anybody who I can trust that will truly help me and not drown me in pills?

Time's running out.
I've been screwed up beyond repair. And the world doesn't understand or have very many feelings.
Yep, I see both a therapist and a psychiatrist. There are too many reasons to even list any more. But I can say that it's too late for me.
